name: A Cruel Diagnosis
source:
A Cruel Diagnosis is a horror game where you go to the GP to get an Autism referral, but face an ignorant and incompetent man.

[From [url=https://halloweenjester.itch.io/a-cruel-diagnosis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《残酷诊断》是一款恐怖游戏，你去全科医生处寻求自闭症转诊，但却面对一个无知无能的男人。

[来自[url=https://halloweenjester.itch.io/a-cruel-diagnosis]itch.io[/url]]
